unit_rules.name: Parasitic Infection
unit_rules.text: When this model destroys an Infantry model with its Barbed Ovipositor, after attacks finish you may add a new Ankle Biters unit of d3 models within 3" of this model (may set up within Engagement Range of the destroyed model's unit but not other enemies).

unit_rules.name: Itching Terror
unit_rules.text: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range; that unit must take a Battle-Shock test.
